summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.21, Sett support affiche 43,4 % de victoires sur 915 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier B. Il souffre surtout contre Leona, Blitzcrank et Thresh.
summary.en: On patch 16.21, Sett support has a 43.4% win rate over 915 ranked games (Emerald+), B tier. It struggles most against Leona, Blitzcrank and Thresh.
